result.title: Fresh Enough to Decide: Age of Intelligence for Cost-Aware Model Synchronization in Dynamic IoT Systems
result.summary: Resource-constrained IoT devices cache learned models for real-time decisions, but frequent updates incur substantial bandwidth, energy, and service overhead. Because decision-relevant model differences need not grow with elapsed time, we define Age of Intelligence (AoInt) as a model-version-relative, client-specific, and action utility distortion, and formulate synchronization as a tradeoff between stale-decision regret and refresh cost. Furthermore, we develop Kullback-Leibler-aware AoInt Synchronization (KL-AoIntSync), which accumulates output-distribution changes using client-specific unlabeled probes, whereas Parameter-aware AoInt Synchronization (Param-AoIntSync) uses a server-broadcast scalar parameter change. Then, we establish pathwise guarantees with fixed client distributions, action sets, and utilities. The numerical results show that calibrated Param-AoIntSync reduces joint synchronization cost by 6.15% relative to an Instant-Parameters policy while performing comparably to KL-AoIntSync.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对资源受限 IoT 设备缓存模型并需决定何时同步更新的问题，提出 Age of Intelligence（AoInt）指标，将「决策相关」的模型陈旧度刻画为随版本、客户端和动作效用而异的失真，并把同步建模为陈旧决策遗憾与刷新成本的权衡，进而给出基于输出分布漂移（KL-AoIntSync）与参数变化（Param-AoIntSync）的两类策略及路径保证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「决策相关陈旧度 + 刷新成本」的价值-of-information 视角可能可供核查 LVR 中的 LOOK/STOP 权衡与动态计算评价：是否能以对决策效用的影响而非时间或表示距离来定义何时需要重新获取视觉证据。
